text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires threads to be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, but no thread feature or dimension exists anywhere on the drawing. This contradicts the drawing content and will confuse manufacturing; the designer should remove the thread-related instructions from N3 or add the missing thread dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Remove references to threads in note N3, or add the required thread dimensions and features to the drawing."},{"rule_id":"WF-014","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS :REF NOTE HARDNESS & DEPTH : REF NOTE FINISH & DEPTH :REF NOTE TEST COUPON SIZE : 18X17.5(20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N7","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING (IF APPLICABLE) RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N6 specifies 'WELD CLASS : B' but note N7 lists no weld-specific NDT method (only raw material UT, heat treatment DP+UT, and finished component MPI).
